episodes.title: Eu tinha um sonho
episodes.summary: Raised in a soccer household with a talented brother, Ronaldinho finds passion that changes his life — and sets him on a path straight to the World Cup.

episodes.title: O melhor do mundo
episodes.summary: After the 2002 World Cup, Ronaldinho ascends to global superstardom — but his lifestyle doesn't sit well with everyone.

episodes.title: Disseram que eu estava acabado?
episodes.summary: Ronaldinho returns to Brazil to achieve a final goal in his career and reconnect with his roots. He finds unprecedented support during difficult times.
